The '''Burnin Konn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]].
